scenes.say: How do you keep goroutines from running wild in Go? What keeps them under control?

scenes.label: Limit
scenes.sub: Too many goroutines can overwhelm memory and CPU.
scenes.say: Always limit the number of concurrent goroutines. Too many can overwhelm memory and CPU.
Use WaitGroups to coordinate goroutines. Combine with context for cancellation and clean exits.
Monitor for leaks, profile with pprof, and always ensure goroutines exit cleanly.

scenes.question: What happens if you forget to cancel?
scenes.wrong: Goroutines just finish on their own.
scenes.right: Uncanceled goroutines can leak, wasting resources and causing bugs.
scenes.say: If you forget to cancel, goroutines can leak. That wastes resources and causes bugs.
